summary_short: EchoStar's Q2 FY2026 revenue was $3.58B, down 4.0% y/y, while net income swung to $8.46B from a year-ago loss; shareholders' equity fell 28.3% y/y to $14.16B and cash fell 81.2% y/y to $440.0M.
summary_long: Revenue was $3.58B, down 4.0% y/y. Gross profit rose 35.2% y/y to $1.23B, lifting gross margin to roughly 34.4% of revenue from 24.4% a year earlier. Diluted EPS was $24.12 versus a $1.06 loss per share a year ago, and net income was $8.46B versus a $306.1M loss a year earlier. Operating income turned positive at $512.9M versus a $213.4M loss a year ago. Shareholders' equity fell 28.3% y/y to $14.16B, and total cash fell 81.2% y/y to $440.0M.
